what: US singer D4vd charged with murder stemming from death of missing teenage girl

clean_source_blocks.text: Prosecutors say the singer, real name David Anthony Burke, could face life in prison due to the nature of the case.

The Los Angeles County District Attorney's Office on Monday, April 20, announced that the 21-year-old singer-songwriter, whose real name is David Anthony Burke, will be charged with first-degree murder with special circumstances, continuous lewd acts with an individual under 14 and mutilating human remains of a body.
US musician D4vd has been charged with first-degree murder in the death of a teenage girl who vanished last year, officials say.
Burke, 21, also was charged with murder for "financial gain" and with murder of a witness to an investigation, the Los Angeles district attorney said.
